sections.wikitext:
This Minor hero card has only 3 attack and 2 defense also it hasn't any powers, you can better use a minor hero like [[TCG:SAS-065|Lok Lambert: Courageous Novice]] because it has 3 attack and 3 defense and has a Combat action. You can also use [[TCG:SAS-051|Daktari: Enigmatic Ally]] as a substitute because it has the same attack and defense with the additional power of '''Sudden Arrival'''.
